name: Mail
summary: Read and send Gmail with the keypad
description: Check your inbox, open threads and send replies on the flip phone. Import your own Gmail setup file before signing in.
author: thooton

changes.text: Google's sign-in busy or failing is said as such, not as a refused login; late work after the app closes is dropped.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Set up from a setup file, the user's own Gmail login or a command center; no login built in.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Down in a dialog now ends on Save, not Cancel.
Writing before Mail is set up no longer crashes, and the d-pad reaches every field.
Suggest people as an address is typed in To or Cc, from your mail and your organization's directory.
Write to the SD card through Android's folder grant.
